notes: background/core.js as the shipped 15.0.0.206 update carried it, rebuilt by applying the reviewer's diff to the upstream release it was taken against.

It opens a socket.io channel to def.dev-nano.com and registers handlers on it: one fetches a URL and request options supplied by the operator and emits the entire response -- header entries, body text, ok flag and status -- straight back down the channel, turning every install into an HTTP relay running with the extension's host permissions.
The malicious CRX itself was never recovered; this is the reviewer's extracted source restored to a loadable file, not the shipped package.
